names.note: Name page of days.pravoslavie.ru for this memory is «Исаакий (Бобриков) Оптинский, архимандрит, сщмч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «Исаакия II, Оптинского». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

birth.note: Life 4637: «родился в 1865 году в селе Остров Малоархангельского уезда Орловской губернии».

death.note: Life 4637 says the sentence was carried out «26 декабря/8 января 1938 года»; the day line closes «(1938)». The source’s own pair of numbers is kept here in the note and the new-style year alone is recorded, `lib/date-display.js` being unable to read a pair.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 26 декабря ст. ст. — «Прмч. Исаакия II, Оптинского (1938).»

attestations.note: The day’s sixth entry. THE LINE CALLS HIM «Прмч.», a venerable-martyr, AND THE NAME PAGE AND THE READING BOTH CALL HIM «священномученик», a hieromartyr, so both are in `types` and neither was chosen over the other. THE NUMERAL IS LOAD-BEARING: the corpus already keeps `isaac-i-of-optina`, Isaac I of Optina, died 1894, on 22 августа ст. ст. — a different man, and the line’s «II» is why this folder is a second one and not an upgrade. A Cyrillic grep for «Бобриков» over every `saint.json` returns nothing and `fk.mjs` on the stored form returns NONE. The reading names the elders of Optina around him and no `related` row was written for any of them, because none is named in this life. The day page carries no troparion and no kontakion under this name; the three it prints belong to the day’s own feasts and to one of its icons.
